summary: BÆRUM MATVÆRK AS (org. no. 937 312 601) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bærum, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2026-03-09. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 56.110 (Drift av restauranter); it has 9 registered employees. Board chair: Julie Marie Koch.
